rules.note: Exports of advanced chips are controlled, but access to the chips through a cloud service is not, as of the source date
rules.quote: Providing access to advanced chips — like that of Nvidia — or advanced AI models through the cloud is not a violation of US regulations since only exports or transfers of a commodity, software or technology are regulated.

rules.note: Passed the House by 369 votes to 22 on 12 January 2026; not passed by the Senate as of October 2026
rules.quote: H R 2683 2/3 YEA-AND-NAY 12-Jan-2026 6:56 PM QUESTION: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended BILL TITLE: Remote Access Security Act

rules.note: Issued on 15 January 2025 and rescinded before its compliance date of 15 May 2025
rules.quote: Today, the Department of Commerce (DOC) announced a rescission of the Biden Administration’s AI Diffusion Rule, while rolling out additional steps to strengthen export controls on semiconductors worldwide.

rules.instrument: Licensing requirements for exports of advanced chips to Malaysia and Thailand
rules.note: Announced with the rescission; the source does not confirm that the requirement took effect
rules.quote: Imposing additional export licensing requirements for exports of SI chips to Malaysia and Thailand, due to known instances of diversion.

rules.instrument: Guidance on the training of Chinese AI models with US chips
rules.quote: Issuing guidance warning the public about the potential consequences of allowing U.S. SI chips to be used for training and inference of Chinese SI models.

rules.instrument: Strategic Trade Act 2010, permit for US-origin AI chips
rules.note: Covers exports, transshipments and transits of US-origin high-performance AI chips
rules.quote: all exports, transshipments and transits of high-performance AI chips of US origin would need to come with a Strategic Trade Permit “effective immediately”.

rules.instrument: Strategic Trade Act 2010, permit for US-origin AI chips
rules.note: The permit does not cover the use of the chips within Malaysia
rules.quote: The rule does not completely cut off access — chips can still be used within Malaysia — but it puts projects with Chinese investors under closer watch.

rules.instrument: Approvals of AI chip exports to G42 and Humain
rules.note: Up to the equivalent of 35,000 Nvidia GB300 chips for each company, on condition of security and reporting requirements that are not public
rules.quote: The approvals are conditioned on both companies meeting rigorous security and reporting requirements.

rules.instrument: Regulated Technology Environment of the US-UAE AI Acceleration Partnership
rules.note: Described by the UAE ambassador to the United States; the terms are not public
rules.quote: approved UAE organizations acquiring regulated U.S. technologies will adhere to extensive physical and cybersecurity protocols. These involve regular audits, third-party validations, and active oversight by both nations’ governments.

rules.instrument: Guidance on licences for advanced chips for entities with a parent in China or Macau
rules.note: Requires a licence for advanced chips for any entity whose ultimate parent is in China or Macau, wherever the entity is, a rule that BIS says has applied since November 2023
rules.quote: issued guidance on May 31 clarifying that export licenses are required for advanced computing chips destined for any entity whose ultimate parent company is headquartered in China or Macau, regardless of where that entity is situated.

rules.instrument: BIS enforcement review of remote access by Chinese AI firms
rules.note: A review reported by Bloomberg that lists countries where Chinese firms reach chips remotely; it is not a rule, and remote access remains legal
rules.quote: The review builds two lists. One names countries running black markets that move restricted Nvidia chips physically into China, which sits squarely in enforcement’s remit. The other names countries where Chinese firms tap the chips remotely.

rules.instrument: Draft rule on sales of advanced chips to Malaysia and Thailand
rules.note: Reported as shelved, so the requirement announced in May 2025 did not become a rule
rules.quote: Commerce shelved its own draft rules, including one curbing sales to Malaysia and Thailand over diversion fears.

rules.instrument: Statement of the Ministry of Investment, Trade and Industry on AI servers
rules.note: Servers with Nvidia and other AI chips are not controlled goods in Malaysia, and data centres may decide whom to serve within Malaysian law
rules.quote: Miti said that servers using Nvidia and AI chips are not classified as controlled goods in Malaysia, and businesses — including data centres — operating in Malaysia are free to make their own commercial decisions as long as they comply with Malaysian laws and regulations.

rules.instrument: Prosecutions for fraud on suppliers of AI servers
rules.note: Charges of fraud for false representations to server suppliers about end users, under general law rather than a rule on AI chips
rules.quote: Singapore prosecutors charged one more person with fraud today ‌for making false representations to US server supplier Dell Technologies, linking her to two other individuals charged with similar offences in February last year.
